adapter_changes: PROTOCOL VIOLATION, recorded deliberately: program.md section 1 declares prepare.py immutable ('only train.py is the normal mutable path'). Every prepare.py change below departs from Karpathy's benchmark. They are defensible as an OPHIS scope and are NOT defensible as a reproduction of his benchmark.

train.py: upstream + protocol adapter ONLY (38 lines added, 3 replaced) -- executable seed, total clock started before the torch import, one AUTORESEARCH_METRICS line. Model, optimizer, schedules, dataloader call sites and evaluator are upstream bytes.

prepare.py: CACHE_DIR pinned to ~/.cache/autoresearch_v2. REASON, measured on 2026-08-17: upstream reads the shared ~/.cache/autoresearch, whose directory listing silently defines dataset_split. That cache held 41 shards (00001-00040, no 00000) and a CORRECTED token_bytes.pt written by an earlier campaign on 2026-07-30, which upstream reuses because it never version-checks the file. So pristine CODE did not give pristine MEASUREMENT, and the split could change with no code change at all.

prepare.py: corrected byte-fallback BPB denominator via decode_single_token_bytes, versioned as token_bytes format 2 and version-checked at load, so a stale or unversioned table now fails loudly instead of being reused in silence.

prepare.py: pre-tokenized flat token cache (uint16 tokens + document offsets + per-batch document counts, memory-mapped), replacing inline BPE in the training loop. NOT throughput-only in effect. The token stream is byte-identical (verified over 12 batches of inputs+targets+epoch), but under a 300-charged-SECOND budget a faster pipeline yields ~3.76x more optimizer steps and a better model, so this changes the benchmark. Byte-identity establishes that the DATA is unchanged, not that the RESULT is comparable to an upstream run. Digest, both hashing 15fcca1c6bd1502397c287415c722c2c8d8171a604790f62a33f6bf2529a5a1d. Falls back to inline tokenization when no current cache exists.

Reference: pristine upstream measured 1.140787 +/- 0.000614 (n=3) at 215.3 steps on this box, against the SHARED 41-shard cache. This scope pins a different 10-shard corpus, so it needs its own baseline and is NOT comparable to that number.
